title.text: Graduate Research Assistant at [SET Lab](https://solardt.github.io/web/) (Government-Funded Research Project)
title.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

items.label: Organization
items.value: EECE, Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST)

items.label: Responsibilities
value: Planned and supported the setup of the SET research lab.
Designing system architecture and data flow for embedded devices and monitoring components.
Developing ML/DL/RL model structures for the Digital Twin workstream.
Maintaining project website and technical documentation.
Preparing technical tender and public procurement documents.
Coordinating with industry partners and vendors.

labelStyle.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

description.value: In this role, I focus on practical system design and documentation for a government-funded research program covering lab setup, whole system architecture, and digital-twin model planning. The scope is research-driven, but the outputs are built to be implementable

title.text: Student Researcher at [Visual Image Processing](https://vip-eece.mist.ac.bd/) (VIP) Lab
title.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

items.label: Organization
items.value: EECE, Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST)

items.label: What I did
value: Collected and processed lip-reading video data from 150 Bengali speakers for machine learning research.
Created the first and largest Bengali lip-reading dataset for low-resource language studies
Validated the dataset using LipNet-based deep learning models and baseline experiments
Performed model training, evaluation, and result analysis as a student researcher
Participated in literature review, experiments, and research documentation

labelStyle.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

description.value: In this Lab I learned formal Research methodologies and practices. I worked on data collection, preprocessing, model training, and evaluation for a Bengali lip-reading dataset. This experience enhanced my skills in machine learning, data analysis, and research documentation.

title.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

items.label: What I did
value: Developed scalable, portable firmware for embedded control systems (including ECU ignition and hydropower valve control).
Wrote user-facing firmware documentation for handover and maintenance.
Contributed to product architecture and system design for custom devices (e.g., smart medicine box, hardware wallet concepts).
Designed and developed custom PCBs to support prototypes and products.

labelStyle.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

description.value: This role strengthened my industry workflow: designing firmware that can be reused across variants, writing documentation that helps others maintain it, and collaborating across hardware and product design constraints.

title.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

items.label: What I did
value: Automated a water treatment plant using microcontroller-based systems and sensors.
Co-developed a CCTV-based fire detection and protection system.
Designed GUIs for HMI displays as a modern alternative to traditional panels.
Developed controller apps for machine interfaces.
Delivered a custom robotics solution to address foam accumulation in an effluent treatment plant reservoir.

labelStyle.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

description.value: I worked on applied R&D projects where reliability and clear user interaction mattered—spanning sensing, embedded control, and practical UI/HMI design. The focus was always on solutions that operators could actually use and maintain.

title.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

items.label: What I did
value: Learned about assemly line processes for product manufacturing and quality assurance.
Conducted testing and troubleshooting for power electronics products.
Learned about Robotic Process Automation (RPA) applications in manufacturing.
Observed CNC machine operations and maintenance procedures.
Got an overview of product design and development workflows.

labelStyle.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

description.value: Here I learned about manufacturing processes, quality assurance, RPA and practical aspects of product assembly. This experience gave me insight into how design decisions impact production and reliability.

title.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

items.label: What I did
value: Learned about complex manufacturing made simple by step by step processes.
Conducted testing and troubleshooting for power electronics ICs.
Grasped the concept of assembled in Bangladesh for global brands.
Got a training on Static Based Handling and ESD safety measures.

labelStyle.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

description.value: This internship provided me with insights into large-scale manufacturing processes, quality control, and ESD safety practices. It highlighted the importance of precision and consistency in producing electronics for global markets.

title.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

items.label: Organization
items.value: [MRC](https://mist.ac.bd/page/robotics-club), EECE, Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST)

items.label: What I did
value: Organized and ran robotics events (line follower race, soccer bot, student orientations), including planning, rules, and logistics.
Designed and delivered hands-on technical classes on robotics and embedded systems; guided members through demos and small projects.
Led an 8-person executive team (VPs and student advisors), delegating responsibilities and tracking execution.
Coordinated collaborations with other student organizations to grow participation and build cross-club initiatives.
Mentored junior members on competition preparation, teamwork, and practical prototyping.

labelStyle.font: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial

description.value: This role strengthened my leadership and teaching skills: turning complex ideas into approachable lessons, aligning a team around shared goals, and building partnerships to run impactful events.
